problem: The registered v0 reachability funnel used the union of gold and supporting-evidence document IDs, so supporting-only arrival could be mistaken for an answer-bearing gold-document exposure failure.
simplest_baseline: Reuse only the frozen 110 calibrated-Judge-wrong traces and distinguish literal answer coverage in gold documents, supporting-evidence documents, their union, and bracket-cited documents. Make no new model, search, Judge, or GPU call.
hypothesis: The correction will produce mutually exclusive queues that do not confuse supporting-only retrieval with gold-document span exposure, without promoting any runtime intervention.
changed_mechanisms: replace union-only reference arrival with a gold-versus-supporting-evidence causal trace classification
anti_claim: This is a selected-after-v0, posthoc development localization correction. It changes no model parameter or runtime harness behavior and cannot demonstrate a harness gain or model-capability improvement.

framework_comparisons.current_gap: Adding workers before separating gold-document absence from span exposure would repeat the same weak evidence arrival under more contexts.
Compression or synthesis changes are only relevant to cases where gold-document answer spans are already visible in a frozen trace.
Broad crawler expansion is not the smallest response while the corrected diagnostic still mixes no-reference and supporting-only arrival cases.
Parallel research is only eligible after a separate trace shows independent branch omission rather than an undifferentiated retrieval/evidence frontier.

frozen_controls: the exact 110 calibrated-Judge-wrong query IDs bound by an LF-delimited SHA-256
the full v10 summary, every referenced run hash, development gold slice, failure profile, and Judge result
gold document IDs separated from supporting evidence IDs before answer coverage
saved snippets and successful open contents only
all-answer-atom literal coverage and bracketed known-docid citation parsing
zero provider, online-search, Judge, GPU, or sealed-holdout calls
promotion_allowed=false and no effect-size or threshold rule
next_action: Keep this result as a selected-after-v0 queue map, not a mechanism promotion. Before any paid runtime change, preregister one fresh-slice, one-variable test that targets only one queue; keep no-reference and supporting-only cases separate, do not repeat the rejected global span-opening policy, and retain B3/B4 multi-Agent as deferred until a trace proves independent-branch omission, context interference, contradictory evidence, or serial latency.
claim_boundary: Among 110 calibrated-Judge-wrong development traces, the selected-after-v0 correction assigns 40 to no reference arrival, 21 to supporting-evidence-only arrival, 31 to gold arrival with incomplete literal answer span, 8 to gold-visible but uncited answer evidence, 7 to cited answer-bearing evidence with a Judge-wrong final answer, and 3 to answer-contract failure. These queue counts are posthoc localization proxies, not runtime harness effectiveness, fresh benchmark gains, official accuracy, sealed-holdout performance, framework superiority, or model-capability improvement.
